_note: Stardew Valley is not installed on Batman-3 yet. Install via Steam, then this config points at the default Steam path. Edit game_exe if yours lands elsewhere.

interact.desc: Interact / talk / check (E is inventory; C also interacts in some contexts).

goal: Play Stardew Valley. Explore the farm and town: walk around, open chests and doors, talk to villagers (walk up to them and interact), manage inventory with the hotbar. If a menu or dialogue is open, read it and close/advance it sensibly. If a cutscene plays, wait. Tool use (watering, hoeing, chopping) needs mouse clicks - use the click_at MCP tool for those, aiming at tiles near the character.
name: Stardew Valley
rules: Pick exactly one action per tick.
Prefer walking toward points of interest: doors, paths, villagers, crops.
If a dialogue box is on screen, read it, then close_menu to advance.
If inventory or any menu is open and you're done, close_menu.
Don't walk into water or off the map edges.
